facts.fact: 章首 Roger 仰面躺在血里；他后背的伤来自当年摔下楼梯，此后一直没好，他几乎动不了，也翻不了身。
facts.anchor: Roger is on his back—his fucking back, never been the same since he fell down those stairs—he can barely move, can’t roll over, blood everywhere—

facts.fact: 据 Roger 说，Nate 讲过 Saskia 是个 bitch，可她交租准时、从不惹麻烦，这在他眼里就是好房客。
facts.anchor: but she always paid on time and didn’t cause any problems, and that’s a good tenant right there.

facts.fact: Roger 自述偷偷往 Lucy 的公寓里塞了一台新摄像头，理由是要确认她没干坏事。
facts.anchor: Snuck a new camera into Lucy’s apartment so he could make sure she wasn’t up to no good.

facts.fact: 据 Roger 说，Lucy 也许弄掉了第一台摄像头，但永远找不到第二台和第三台。
facts.anchor: Maybe Lucy got rid of the first camera, but she’ll never find the second one. Or the third.

facts.fact: 他把装摄像头、当房东这件事说成自己的投资，并说要靠它送孙子上大学。
Roger 说自己不介意看两人亲热的前半段，理由那是他的权利，事情发生在他的床上。
facts.anchor: He didn’t mind watching the first part—that’s his right, it happened in his bed—

facts.fact: Roger 说 Saskia 用棒球棒打了他。
facts.anchor: She hit him with a fucking bat!

facts.fact: Lucy 拿着的那尊大理石胸像原属 Nate；Nate 说那是他祖母的东西。
facts.anchor: That was Nate’s marble bust. Said it belonged to his grandmother.

facts.fact: Roger 嫌那尊胸像没用、不值钱又重，把它送去了 Goodwill 二手店。
facts.anchor: Roger took it to Goodwill just to get rid of it.

facts.fact: Roger 口齿不清地命令 Lucy 叫救护车（下文单独一行写明 Call an ambulance.）。
章末 Lucy 把那尊大理石胸像砸在 Roger 脸上。
facts.anchor: And she drops the marble bust on his face.
